period_note: Sourced from the Annual Report 2025's own 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials (Consolidated) by The Audit Committee and by The Board' table. *** BASIS MISMATCH: this table's data is genuinely CONSOLIDATED, NOT Solo, while this dataset's main Q4/annual series for FY2025 is Solo/Bank-Total *** (bank_financials/PREMIERBAN/quarterly/2025_Q4.json: Total Assets 423,551.38m, Total Equity 17,146.71m, PAT -9,785.41m). PROOF: this table's Dec-31-2025 column (Total Property and Assets 423,820.15m, Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity 16,767.82m, Net Profit After Tax -9,925.90m, NAV 13.59) reproduces EXACTLY against the FY2025 report's own separate, full Consolidated Balance Sheet/Consolidated Profit and Loss Account (Total Assets 423,820,153,819; Total [Shareholders'+NCI] Equity 16,767,817,577; Profit after taxation -9,925,895,435) and the Balance Sheet's own labelled 'Consolidated Net asset value (NAV) per share' of 13.59 exactly -- all diverging from the Solo/Bank-Total figures. Q1/Q2/Q3 2025 figures below are therefore also Consolidated. VALIDATION FLAG (not an error, explained): cumulative Consolidated figures deteriorate throughout the year instead of growing -- Net Interest Income cumulative goes 968.65 (Q1) to -930.03 (Q2) to -3,106.06 (Q3) to -5,949.83 (annual); Net Profit After Tax cumulative goes 278.56 (Q1) to -1,365.65 (Q2) to -6,777.50 (Q3) to -9,925.90 (annual) -- each successive discrete quarter was worse than the cumulative trend to date. This is a genuine reported deterioration (interest expense overtaking interest income intra-year; matches the already-documented FY2025 crisis: NPL 31.01%, CRAR 5.70%), not a data error. SECOND VALIDATION FLAG (genuine source anomaly, verified byte-for-byte against the report text, not a transcription error here): the table's own cumulative 'Total Provision for Loans, Investment & Other' row is NON-MONOTONIC -- Q1 639.13, Q2 639.13 (identical to Q1, implying zero incremental Q2 provisioning), Q3 562.67 (LOWER than both Q1 and Q2, implying a net provision write-back/reversal of approximately -76.46m in Q3 discrete), Annual 1,000.00. A cumulative-from-Jan-1 figure decreasing quarter-on-quarter is only possible with a net reversal exceeding that quarter's new charges; this cannot be independently corroborated (no second source exists for FY2025 interim data) and is recorded here as-reported, not smoothed or corrected. No Solo-basis version of the Q1-Q3 2025 interim data was found elsewhere in the report text. No independent same-period comparator table exists to cross-check for restatement (single-current-year-only table).
